model.title: A resolution designating September 30, 2026, as "National Veterans Suicide Prevention Day".

summary.text: The resolution would designate September 30, 2026, as "National Veterans Suicide Prevention Day" to raise awareness about suicide prevention efforts among veterans and honor those affected by veteran suicide.
